trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what happened and what I did:

**Issue:** The latest checkout-api deployment (v2.3.1) was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with an error rate of ~18%.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Rolled back to v2.3.0** — the most recent release with a verified healthy status in production — across all production regions. No approval was required since v2.3.0 had previously been healthy in production.
2. **Verified recovery:** checkout-api is now healthy in all three regions, with the error rate back down to ~0.2%.
3. **Opened a SEV2 incident (INC-0001)** describing the failure and the rollback, and the on-call engineer has been paged.

The root cause of the v2.3.1 failure still needs investigation — the incident is open for the on-call to follow up.
